title: THE UNMADE — Canonical Game Codex
goal: One canonical rule/dependency ledger for abilities, enemies, crafting, experience, skills, realms, journeys, quests, rewards and consequences.
authority: Canonical whole-game design and requirements authoring ledger. Migrated study and Atlas checklist strings are generated into C++; live source rule models still execute and enforce the save state. Other mirrored domains require source-parity checks until individually migrated. Do not claim all gameplay runtime rules are Codex-driven yet.

rules_of_authoring: No powers from observation alone: require actual evidence and earned mastery.
Crafting consumes authentic source-registry resources, capacity and profession skill atomically.
Enemy lore is not identical to an executable combat skill.
Journeys require evidence, travel, actual witnesses and persistent choices.
NPC consent and provenance must never be bypassed by omniscient text.
Later realm designs must not masquerade as navigable levels.
Preserve saved IDs and schema; append new records instead of renumbering.
Generate and verify engine references from Codex and migrate executors by tests.
All world atlas realms and passage thresholds are generated from Codex; route graphs cannot invent unbuilt Unreal levels.
